title: Black Rhino Painting vs. Precision Paint Experts
description: Comparing Black Rhino Painting and Precision Paint Experts for an exterior repaint? See which exterior prep steps to confirm in writing before work begins.
h1: Black Rhino Painting vs. Precision Paint Experts
heroIntro: Exterior paint fails from the surface underneath, so this guide focuses on the prep scope North Central Florida homeowners should confirm with every bidder.

questions: What exterior prep should a painting quote include?
Why does exterior paint peel in Florida?

sections.h2: An exterior bid is really a prep bid
body: Black Rhino Painting is one of the painting and property-service companies North Central Florida homeowners may be comparing for exterior work. Rather than compare companies, this page compares prep scopes, because on an exterior the paint is only as good as the surface it lands on. Heat, humidity, afternoon storms, and pollen all test a coating, and the ones that fail early usually failed at the prep stage.

That makes the prep section the most important page of any exterior quote, and often the shortest. A line that reads "prep as needed" gives you nothing to hold a contractor to. A line that lists each step, the areas it applies to, and how repairs are priced gives you a real basis for comparison. The checklist below is the one we would use if we were collecting bids on our own homes.

sections.h2: Prep steps to confirm, one by one
body: Ask each bidder to tell you, in writing, which of these steps are part of the price:
bullets: Washing the whole exterior and allowing proper dry time
Scraping and sanding loose or failing paint
Mildew treatment on shaded walls and eaves
Rot and fascia replacement, priced separately
Re-caulking joints, trim, and window perimeters
Spot-priming bare wood and repaired areas

sections.h2: What our exterior prep days look like
body: Every Precision Paint Experts exterior follows the same order: walkthrough, written estimate, prep days, application, and a final punch walk that you sign. Prep days cover the wash, scrape, sand, mildew treatment, nail pops, rot and fascia replacement, re-caulking, and spot-priming before any finish coat goes on. During the walkthrough, the crew lead photographs conditions and takes moisture readings where siding or trim looks suspect.

We put 100% acrylic on siding and trim, and where we spray, we back-brush or back-roll so the coating works into the surface rather than sitting on top. Our exterior painting page covers the full system, and our pressure washing and soft washing service explains the cleaning step in more detail.

sections.h2: Signs your house needs more than a coat of paint
body: If you see blistering, peeling near the ground, soft trim, or cracked window frames, ask every contractor how they will address the cause, not just the symptom. Our guides on humidity and paint peeling and hidden siding moisture damage explain what to look for before you collect bids.

A full exterior usually takes three to seven working days plus washing and dry time, and the best season here runs from October through May. Exterior projects carry a written workmanship warranty of up to 10 years on top of the manufacturer's product warranty. Ask every bidder for warranty terms on paper before you choose.

When you request our estimate, the crew lead will walk every elevation, note problem areas in photos, and send an itemized quote usually within one business day. Compare its prep section line by line against any other bid, and ask questions about anything that looks thin, including ours.

faqs.q: Is Precision Paint Experts the same company as Black Rhino Painting?
faqs.a: No. We are a separate, locally owned company based in Newberry, FL, and this page is a buyer's guide rather than a review.

faqs.q: Is rot repair included in your exterior painting price?
faqs.a: Rot and fascia replacement is part of our prep process, and it is written into the estimate so you can see exactly what is being repaired.

faqs.q: Can you paint an exterior in the summer?
faqs.a: Yes. October through May is the best window, but in summer we work earlier in the day and watch dew point and radar closely.
